programme.title: Kakodalogija
programme.desc: Emisija Kakodalogija, autora i voditelja Ivana Stankovića, otkriva šta se zaista krije iza velikih životnih i profesionalnih ostvarenja poznatih ličnosti i traži odgovor na pitanje – kako se postaje uspešan? Kroz jednosatne razgovore jedan na jedan sa ljudima koji su napravili značajne karijere i ostavili trag u svetu biznisa, kulture, sporta i javnog života, Ivan Stanković istražuje ono što često ostaje izvan poznatih biografija – neuspehe, pogrešne odluke, trenutke sumnje, strahove, prekretnice i izazove koji su oblikovali put njegovih sagovornika. Polazeći od jednostavnog pitanja kako da?, Kakodalogija istražuje kako prepoznati pravu priliku, doneti odluku kada nema dovoljno informacija, nastaviti nakon promašaja ili velikog pada i pronaći snagu za novi početak. Kroz konkretna iskustva gostiju, emisija otkriva koliko su na putu do cilja važni talenat i sreća, a koliko upornost, disciplina, hrabrost i spremnost na promene. Kakodalogija tako prevazilazi okvir klasičnog biografskog razgovora i postaje svojevrsni masterclass o životu, karijeri, ranjivosti i donošenju odluka, nudeći gledaocima ne samo inspiraciju, već i odgovore koji im mogu pomoći u njihovim ličnim kako da pitanjima.

programme.title: Zelena knjiga
programme.desc: Film inspirisan istinitom pričom o odnosu afroameričkog džez pijaniste Dona Širlija i njegovog vozača Frenka, sa kojim je putovao tokom turneje 1962. godine.

programme.title: Poziv
programme.desc: Dugogodišnja operaterka Hitne pomoći dobija poziv od devojke koja je oteta. Kako bi spasila tinejdžerku, operaterka Džordan mora da se suoči sa slučajem iz svoje prošlosti.

programme.title: Iznenadni napad
programme.desc: Psihološki triler u kojem se svakodnevni život običnog čoveka pretvara u noćnu moru kada postane meta misterioznih napadača. Glavni junak pokušava da otkrije ko stoji iza napada, dok se bori za svoj život i traži izlaz iz ove smrtonosne igre koja ga vodi ka zastrašujućoj istini.

programme.title: Panama
programme.desc: Džejmsa Bekera, bivšeg marinca, angažuju da otputuje u Panamu da sklopi posao oko prodaje oružja. Da bi završio posao, Beker mora da se snalazi u haosu građanskog rata i američke invazije, da se suoči sa plaćenim ubicama, udvara se fatalnim ženama i pregovara sa neprijateljima.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Tajne vinove loze
programme.desc: Smeštena u srcu vinogradarskog kraja Srbije, Tajne vinove loze je emotivna porodična saga isprepletena ljubavlju, intrigama i mračnim tajnama. Dve porodice, povezane ljubavlju prema vinu i zajedničkom prošlošću, suočavaju se sa sukobima generacija, rivalstvima i davno zakopanim tajnama koje prete da unište sve što su gradili. Dok se članovi porodica bore za očuvanje porodične časti i nasleđa, kroz njihove priče otkrivaju se strastvene ljubavi, izdaje i lične tragedije. Vinogradi postaju svedoci sukoba tradicije i modernih ambicija, dok prošlost neprestano utiče na sadašnjost.

programme.title: Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Posle očeve smrti, tri sestre – Eleni, Asimina i Droso pokušavaju da opstanu i prežive u malom i izrazito konzervativnom mestu u Grčkoj. Sergios je najmoćniji zemljoposednik i uticajan meštanin koji po svaku cenu želi da oženi sina najstarijom sestrom Eleni kako bi se dokopao njihovog imanja. Ona nevoljno pristaje na ponudu jer zna da je to jedini način da se reše dugova u koje su upale posle smrti oba roditelja. Sestre nisu ni slutile kakva će ih sudbina zadesiti posle takve odluke. U noći venčanja, Eleni i Asimina uprljaće ruke mladoženjinom krvlju sprečavajući ga u pokušaju silovanja njihove najmlađe sestre Droso. Meštani će biti šokirani kada telo mladog, bahatog naslednika bude otkriveno. Tri sestre čine sve kako se istina ne bi otkrila dok svemoćna porodica ne preza ni od čega kako bi pronašla pravog krivca. U tom pokušaju, najmračnije tajne iz prošlosti izlaze polako na svetlost dana i okreću život svima naopačke.

programme.title: Marisol
programme.desc: Ožiljak na licu, buket cveća u rukama i život koji joj nije bio nimalo naklonjen – tako upoznajemo Marisol, junakinju jedne od najvoljenijih meksičkih telenovela svih vremena. Serija koja je devedesetih osvajala milione gledalaca širom sveta od 31. avgusta stiže na Una televiziju, radnim danima u 14.40 časova. U nezaboravnoj ulozi je Érika Buenfil, koja je Marisol pretvorila u junakinju za koju se navija od prvog do poslednjeg kadra. Skromna devojka prodaje cveće na ulici kako bi prehranila bolesnu majku, ne sluteći da je zapravo naslednica bogate i ugledne porodice. Kada se u njen život umeša ljubav, počinje vrtlog tajni, izdaja i velikih preokreta. Sa Hose Andresom prolazi kroz iskušenja koja će testirati njihovu ljubav do krajnjih granica – uključujući i bolnu potragu za sinom koji im je oduzet. Kada je 1996. godine emitovana u Meksiku i širom Latinske Amerike, Marisol je postala pravi televizijski fenomen, a Érika Buenfil zbog ogromne popularnosti serije krenula je i na promotivnu turneju po Latinskoj Americi i Evropi. I danas ova priča ima posebnu publiku – jer neke telenovele jednostavno ne zastarevaju. A znate li ko je Marisolin partner? Eduardo Santamarina – isti onaj fatalni zavodnik kojeg pamtimo kao Alehandra iz čuvene serije Rubí.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Voleti do smrti
programme.desc: Voleti do smrti je priča o ljubavi, zločinu i osveti koja otkriva tajne života posle smrti. Ovo je priča o drugim prilikama, mogućnosti iskupljenja, mračnim putevima osvete, kao i o odnosu moći i ambicije. Leon Karvahal (Aleksis Ajala) jedan je od dvadeset najbogatijih poslovnih ljudi na svetu. Sa 60 godina odlučuje da se oženi Lusijom Borges (Anhelik Bojer), ženom koja je od njega mlađa tri decenije i izuzetne je lepote. Međutim, venčanje se pretvara u tragediju kada je, usred proslave, slavni milioner ubijen. U istom trenutku događaju se još dve smrti. U zatvoru u Teksasu, na električnoj stolici, pogubljen je opasni ubica poznat kao El Ćino Valdes (Mišel Braun), osuđen na smrtnu kaznu. Istovremeno, profesor Beltran Kamačo (Arturo Barba) gine nakon što njegov automobil sleti u provaliju. Iako se nikada nisu upoznali i njihovi životi nisu bili povezani, sva trojica umiru u istom trenutku, na različitim mestima i pod različitim okolnostima. Njihova smrt pokreće neverovatan niz reinkarnacija koje će zauvek promeniti živote mnogih ljudi.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Cvat lipe na Balkanu
programme.desc: Jugoslavija, vreme nakon Drugog svetskog rata. Junaci pokušavaju da zaleče rane koje su nastale u prethodnim godinama i da se prilagode na život u novostvorenoj državi.

programme.title: Jedne letnje noći
programme.desc: Lola i Krinka su dve sestre, iako veoma različite, obe su veoma lepe i zanimljive. One žive sa roditeljima koji čuvaju veliku tajnu koja se tiče Krinkinog porekla. Sestre zajedno sa majkom kreću na putovanje, posle kog više ništa neće biti isto.

programme.title: Una vesti
programme.desc: Una vesti donose najtačnije informacije o najvažnijim domaćim i svetskim događajima – svakog dana u 13 i 15 časova. Nepristrasno, prodorno i brzo novinarstvo, uz lokalni pristup, čini da gledaoci Una televizije budu pravovremeno i pouzdano informisani. Savremene vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i upotreba virtuelne stvarnosti, pružaju jedinstven i dinamičan doživljaj praćenja informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Jedne letnje noći
programme.desc: Lola i Krinka su dve sestre, iako veoma različite, obe su veoma lepe i zanimljive. One žive sa roditeljima koji čuvaju veliku tajnu koja se tiče Krinkinog porekla. Sestre zajedno sa majkom kreću na putovanje, posle kog više ništa neće biti isto.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 13.30 časova, uz Marijanu Tabaković, Bojanu Bojović i Ivana Vukajlovića, donosi teme koje su deo svakodnevice gledalaca, korisne informacije, stručne savete i razgovore sa zanimljivim sagovornicima. Voditelji se smenjuju u parovima i kroz dinamičan i neposredan razgovor otvaraju različite životne i društvene teme – od zdravlja, porodice i međuljudskih odnosa do svakodnevnih dilema, praktičnih saveta i priča koje zaslužuju pažnju. Uz goste u studiju i priče sa terena, Popodne prati ono što zanima i dotiče gledaoce, u opuštenoj atmosferi i uz mnogo prostora za iskrene razgovore, korisne odgovore i dobru energiju.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 16.30 časova, uz Anu Šupić i Boška Jakovljevića, donosi pregled aktuelnih tema iz zemlje i sveta, razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima i priče reportera sa terena. Poseban prostor posvećen je društvu i kulturi – temama koje pokreću javnost, zanimljivim ljudima i događajima koji obeležavaju svakodnevicu, uz razgovore koji nude različite poglede i odgovore na aktuelna pitanja. Uz poznate ličnosti, priče iz sveta kulture i zabave i muziku benda u studiju, Ana i Boško završnicu dana provode sa gledaocima u prepoznatljivoj atmosferi Popodneva – spontano, neposredno i uz dobru energiju.

programme.title: Gradske priče
programme.desc: Gradske priče su novi serijal Una televizije koji beleži neprolazne priče iz prestonice i drugih delova Srbije. Ovo su priče o stanovnicima gradova Srbije i urbanom okruženju koje ih je takvim napravilo. Teme ove emisije nisu aktuelni događaji, već sve ono što atmosferu grada čini jedinstvenom i neponovljivom. Najstrmija ulica, dan sa čistačem cipela, prva kafana u Evropi, najbolji beogradski đaci, najstariji vozač autobusa, pekara koja postoji 100 godina, žena koja godinama popravlja kišobrane, najteže beogradske škole, najbolji beogradski lekari, mesta za okupljanje, sastanke i rekreaciju, čudesna istorija, robinzoni sa Ratnog ostrva, ljudi sa čudnim hobijima, najlepši beogradski balkon, avanture dostavljača hrane, jutro u samačkom hotelu, dan u birou za izgubljene stvari, kako su nastajale tolike pesme u kojima se spominje Beograd, najduži red za pljeskavicu posle noćnog izlaska, tajna najboljeg beogradskog bureka, cenkanje na pijacama, spokojna šetnja u sred noći - sve je to duh jednog grada u kome svaki ćošak krije priču a svaki prolaznik neponovljivu anegdotu.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Štafeta
programme.desc: Štafeta je emisija Una televizije koja povezuje glasove ljudi iz svih država bivše Jugoslavije, otvarajući prostor za dijalog, razmenu mišljenja i suočavanje različitih pogleda na teme koje nas jednako dotiču. U vremenu kada nas svakodnevica često deli granicama, politikom i različitim interpretacijama prošlosti, Štafeta podseća da region i dalje deli iste emocije, dileme i iskustva. Svaka epizoda donosi jednu centralnu temu – od kulture, muzike i medija do identiteta, društvenih pitanja i života običnih ljudi. Kroz razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima iz Srbije, Hrvatske, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Severne Makedonije i Slovenije, emisija gradi prostor u kojem svako ima pravo na svoj glas. Štafeta ne traži nužno zajednički odgovor, već iskren razgovor i pokušaj da se region ponovo čuje – bez buke, predrasuda i granica.

programme.title: Gospodar i komandant: Daleka strana sveta
programme.desc: Za vreme Napoleonovih ratova, drski britanski kapetan komanduje svojim brodom i posadom do njihovih krajnjih granica izdržljivosti, sve u potrazi za strašnim francuskim, ratnim brodom, ploveći oko obala Južne Amerike.

programme.title: Liga izuzetnih džentlmena
programme.desc: Poznati avanturista Alan Kvotermajn vodi tim izvanrednih ličnosti legendarnih moći u borbi protiv tehnološkog terora ludaka poznatog kao Fantom. Ovu Ligu čine pomorac i pronalazač kapetan Nemo, vampirica Mina Harker, nevidljivi čovek po imenu Rodni Skiner, agent američke tajne službe Tom Sojer, bezvremenski i nepobedivi Dorijan Grej i opasna podeljena ličnost doktora Džekila i gospodina Hajda.

programme.title: Potraga
programme.desc: Rik Kalovej je haker koji je pobegao iz pritvora kako bi spasio svoju otetu ženu iz ruku opakih kriminalaca. Detektiv Majk Breslin spreman je da uradi sve kako bi ga pronašao i vratio u zatvor.

programme.title: Rozario
programme.desc: Rozario je napeti psihološki horor o uspešnoj devojci sa Vol Strita koja biva zarobljena u stanu sa telom svoje preminule bake tokom strašne snežne oluje, dok je napadaju mračne demonske sile.

programme.title: Alo, alo

Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Tajne vinove loze
programme.desc: Smeštena u srcu vinogradarskog kraja Srbije, Tajne vinove loze je emotivna porodična saga isprepletena ljubavlju, intrigama i mračnim tajnama. Dve porodice, povezane ljubavlju prema vinu i zajedničkom prošlošću, suočavaju se sa sukobima generacija, rivalstvima i davno zakopanim tajnama koje prete da unište sve što su gradili. Dok se članovi porodica bore za očuvanje porodične časti i nasleđa, kroz njihove priče otkrivaju se strastvene ljubavi, izdaje i lične tragedije. Vinogradi postaju svedoci sukoba tradicije i modernih ambicija, dok prošlost neprestano utiče na sadašnjost.

programme.title: Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Posle očeve smrti, tri sestre – Eleni, Asimina i Droso pokušavaju da opstanu i prežive u malom i izrazito konzervativnom mestu u Grčkoj. Sergios je najmoćniji zemljoposednik i uticajan meštanin koji po svaku cenu želi da oženi sina najstarijom sestrom Eleni kako bi se dokopao njihovog imanja. Ona nevoljno pristaje na ponudu jer zna da je to jedini način da se reše dugova u koje su upale posle smrti oba roditelja. Sestre nisu ni slutile kakva će ih sudbina zadesiti posle takve odluke. U noći venčanja, Eleni i Asimina uprljaće ruke mladoženjinom krvlju sprečavajući ga u pokušaju silovanja njihove najmlađe sestre Droso. Meštani će biti šokirani kada telo mladog, bahatog naslednika bude otkriveno. Tri sestre čine sve kako se istina ne bi otkrila dok svemoćna porodica ne preza ni od čega kako bi pronašla pravog krivca. U tom pokušaju, najmračnije tajne iz prošlosti izlaze polako na svetlost dana i okreću život svima naopačke.

programme.title: Marisol
programme.desc: Ožiljak na licu, buket cveća u rukama i život koji joj nije bio nimalo naklonjen – tako upoznajemo Marisol, junakinju jedne od najvoljenijih meksičkih telenovela svih vremena. Serija koja je devedesetih osvajala milione gledalaca širom sveta od 31. avgusta stiže na Una televiziju, radnim danima u 14.40 časova. U nezaboravnoj ulozi je Érika Buenfil, koja je Marisol pretvorila u junakinju za koju se navija od prvog do poslednjeg kadra. Skromna devojka prodaje cveće na ulici kako bi prehranila bolesnu majku, ne sluteći da je zapravo naslednica bogate i ugledne porodice. Kada se u njen život umeša ljubav, počinje vrtlog tajni, izdaja i velikih preokreta. Sa Hose Andresom prolazi kroz iskušenja koja će testirati njihovu ljubav do krajnjih granica – uključujući i bolnu potragu za sinom koji im je oduzet. Kada je 1996. godine emitovana u Meksiku i širom Latinske Amerike, Marisol je postala pravi televizijski fenomen, a Érika Buenfil zbog ogromne popularnosti serije krenula je i na promotivnu turneju po Latinskoj Americi i Evropi. I danas ova priča ima posebnu publiku – jer neke telenovele jednostavno ne zastarevaju. A znate li ko je Marisolin partner? Eduardo Santamarina – isti onaj fatalni zavodnik kojeg pamtimo kao Alehandra iz čuvene serije Rubí.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Voleti do smrti
programme.desc: Voleti do smrti je priča o ljubavi, zločinu i osveti koja otkriva tajne života posle smrti. Ovo je priča o drugim prilikama, mogućnosti iskupljenja, mračnim putevima osvete, kao i o odnosu moći i ambicije. Leon Karvahal (Aleksis Ajala) jedan je od dvadeset najbogatijih poslovnih ljudi na svetu. Sa 60 godina odlučuje da se oženi Lusijom Borges (Anhelik Bojer), ženom koja je od njega mlađa tri decenije i izuzetne je lepote. Međutim, venčanje se pretvara u tragediju kada je, usred proslave, slavni milioner ubijen. U istom trenutku događaju se još dve smrti. U zatvoru u Teksasu, na električnoj stolici, pogubljen je opasni ubica poznat kao El Ćino Valdes (Mišel Braun), osuđen na smrtnu kaznu. Istovremeno, profesor Beltran Kamačo (Arturo Barba) gine nakon što njegov automobil sleti u provaliju. Iako se nikada nisu upoznali i njihovi životi nisu bili povezani, sva trojica umiru u istom trenutku, na različitim mestima i pod različitim okolnostima. Njihova smrt pokreće neverovatan niz reinkarnacija koje će zauvek promeniti živote mnogih ljudi.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Cvat lipe na Balkanu
programme.desc: Jugoslavija, vreme nakon Drugog svetskog rata. Junaci pokušavaju da zaleče rane koje su nastale u prethodnim godinama i da se prilagode na život u novostvorenoj državi.

programme.title: Jedne letnje noći
programme.desc: Lola i Krinka su dve sestre, iako veoma različite, obe su veoma lepe i zanimljive. One žive sa roditeljima koji čuvaju veliku tajnu koja se tiče Krinkinog porekla. Sestre zajedno sa majkom kreću na putovanje, posle kog više ništa neće biti isto.

programme.title: Una vesti
programme.desc: Una vesti donose najtačnije informacije o najvažnijim domaćim i svetskim događajima – svakog dana u 13 i 15 časova. Nepristrasno, prodorno i brzo novinarstvo, uz lokalni pristup, čini da gledaoci Una televizije budu pravovremeno i pouzdano informisani. Savremene vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i upotreba virtuelne stvarnosti, pružaju jedinstven i dinamičan doživljaj praćenja informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Jedne letnje noći
programme.desc: Lola i Krinka su dve sestre, iako veoma različite, obe su veoma lepe i zanimljive. One žive sa roditeljima koji čuvaju veliku tajnu koja se tiče Krinkinog porekla. Sestre zajedno sa majkom kreću na putovanje, posle kog više ništa neće biti isto.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 13.30 časova, uz Marijanu Tabaković, Bojanu Bojović i Ivana Vukajlovića, donosi teme koje su deo svakodnevice gledalaca, korisne informacije, stručne savete i razgovore sa zanimljivim sagovornicima. Voditelji se smenjuju u parovima i kroz dinamičan i neposredan razgovor otvaraju različite životne i društvene teme – od zdravlja, porodice i međuljudskih odnosa do svakodnevnih dilema, praktičnih saveta i priča koje zaslužuju pažnju. Uz goste u studiju i priče sa terena, Popodne prati ono što zanima i dotiče gledaoce, u opuštenoj atmosferi i uz mnogo prostora za iskrene razgovore, korisne odgovore i dobru energiju.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 16.30 časova, uz Anu Šupić i Boška Jakovljevića, donosi pregled aktuelnih tema iz zemlje i sveta, razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima i priče reportera sa terena. Poseban prostor posvećen je društvu i kulturi – temama koje pokreću javnost, zanimljivim ljudima i događajima koji obeležavaju svakodnevicu, uz razgovore koji nude različite poglede i odgovore na aktuelna pitanja. Uz poznate ličnosti, priče iz sveta kulture i zabave i muziku benda u studiju, Ana i Boško završnicu dana provode sa gledaocima u prepoznatljivoj atmosferi Popodneva – spontano, neposredno i uz dobru energiju.

programme.title: Gradske priče
programme.desc: Gradske priče su novi serijal Una televizije koji beleži neprolazne priče iz prestonice i drugih delova Srbije. Ovo su priče o stanovnicima gradova Srbije i urbanom okruženju koje ih je takvim napravilo. Teme ove emisije nisu aktuelni događaji, već sve ono što atmosferu grada čini jedinstvenom i neponovljivom. Najstrmija ulica, dan sa čistačem cipela, prva kafana u Evropi, najbolji beogradski đaci, najstariji vozač autobusa, pekara koja postoji 100 godina, žena koja godinama popravlja kišobrane, najteže beogradske škole, najbolji beogradski lekari, mesta za okupljanje, sastanke i rekreaciju, čudesna istorija, robinzoni sa Ratnog ostrva, ljudi sa čudnim hobijima, najlepši beogradski balkon, avanture dostavljača hrane, jutro u samačkom hotelu, dan u birou za izgubljene stvari, kako su nastajale tolike pesme u kojima se spominje Beograd, najduži red za pljeskavicu posle noćnog izlaska, tajna najboljeg beogradskog bureka, cenkanje na pijacama, spokojna šetnja u sred noći - sve je to duh jednog grada u kome svaki ćošak krije priču a svaki prolaznik neponovljivu anegdotu.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. programme.title: Jedno pitanje
programme.desc: Ovaj jedinstveni kviz nije samo test znanja već nesvakidašnja kombinacija znanja, igre i super zabave. Za osvajanje novčane nagrade od čak 500.000,00 dinara takmičarima su potrebni intuicija, malo sreće i nezaobilazna podrška šarmantne voditeljke Marije Kilibarde. Pravila su jednostavna: svaki takmičarski par dobija jedno pitanje i 16 ponuđenih odgovora. Kroz sistem eliminacije, pokušavaju da pronađu jedini tačan odgovor, i uz pažljivo razmišljanje i mrvu odvažnosti, nagrada može biti njihova.

programme.title: Planina koja nas razdvaja
programme.desc: Ben i Aleks su potpuni stranci koji su odlučili da iznajme privatni avion nakon što im je let otkazan u poslednji čas. Tokom leta, pilot doživljava moždani udar i umire, a dvoje ljudi koji se do pre nekoliko sati nisu ni poznavali sada moraju da učine sve kako bi preživeli i našli način da se vrate kući.

programme.desc: Narušavanje sigurnosti motivira Kris na povećanje sigurnosti. Scott odlazi na zabavu Lorda Disicka u Vegas, dok Kourtney saznaje da bi se beba mogla ranije roditi.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Nakon rođenja trećeg djeteta, Scott se prepušta opijanju i zabavama, a Khloé zamoli Brucea neka urazumi Scotta. Kanye snima video s Northom.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Nakon svađe, Kim i Kourtney kreću u Armeniju kako bi krstile svoju djecu. Kourtney razmatra veliku promjenu životnog stila.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kad je Kris na seksualnom vrhuncu u svojoj vezi, ona osjeća krivicu što Khloé prolazi kroz 'suho razdoblje' i pokušava je nagovoriti neka ponovno krene na spojeve.

programme.title: Gledaj što se događa: Uživo s Andyjem Cohenom
programme.desc: Živahne rasprave o najvrućim temama iz pop kulture sa slavnim osobama i protagonistima reality emisija. Gosti iz najpopularnijih serija i druge šoubiz zvijezde razgovaraju o poznatim licima iz vijesti...

programme.title: Bogati klinci s Beverly Hillsa
programme.desc: EJ se pita znači li karijera u modi preseljenje u New York. U međuvremenu, Bianca otkriva da Morgan nije prijateljica, kakvom ju je Dorothy smatrala.

programme.title: Bogati klinci s Beverly Hillsa
programme.desc: Na Morganinoj djevojačkoj zabavi u Miamiju je sve sjajno, dok se Dorothy ne suoči s njom. Bianca odlazi u Miami dati podršku Dorothy.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kada Tristan počne poklanjati Khloe darove, ona je zabrinuta da je to njegov pokušaj kako bi mu se vratila.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kim i Khloé su bijesne zato što Kourtney skriva aspekte svog života od kamera i pokušavaju je otpustiti iz emisije.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Nakon rođenja trećeg djeteta, Scott se prepušta opijanju i zabavama, a Khloé zamoli Brucea neka urazumi Scotta. Kanye snima video s Northom.

programme.desc: Kad se Khloé posvađa s French Montanom, Malika se nađe usred toga. Kris odvlači Kylie putovanje povezivanja majke i kćeri u San Diego.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kris je "puknuo film" sa Scottom kada najprije ne dođe u noćni klub u Vegasu na njen rođendan, a zatim se pojavi pripit i razdražljiv.

Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: Wake of Death
programme.desc: Ben Archer, an ex-mob enforcer, seeks revenge against a ruthless Chinese kingpin responsible for his wife's brutal murder. When Archer joins forces with his old underworld friends, an all-out war is waged against the Chinese Triad.

programme.title: Mexican Sunrise
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Five friends went to Mexico for a bachelor party. Not all of them made it to sunrise.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
The Year Dolly Parton Was My Mom
programme.desc: Elizabeth Alison Gray is just your average suburban 11-year old waiting for adolescence to arrive when she finds out her whole life has been a lie. With only her imagination to guide her, she runs away to find the truth.

programme.title: El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: In 2008, rookie journalist Jay Bahadur forms a half-baked plan to embed himself among the pirates of Somalia. He ultimately succeeds in providing the first close-up look into who these men are, how they live, and the forces that drive them.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: A man leaves a woman, a woman leaves a man. Both meet for a short while. Great changes await them at the end of this journey.

programme.title: Wild Fire
programme.desc: Dream Town Development real estate bosses Jack Del Rio and Sy Richards can't convince animal lover Carol Tanner to sell and relocate safari/animal retirement ranch Wild Land, which she runs with younger sister Ballad since their parents died in a plane crash. Jack hires Bradshaw and Roach to release tiger Caesar, after that fails to cause a scandal to start a forest fire and release all animals, after tying up Carol. Ballad's lover, committed Glendora, southern California fire captain Kennedy, and his jumper team try their best to control the fire. Meanwhile young sheriff Drake Donovan and Ballad drug and catch wild animals. The arson is discovered, but the fiends aren't done yet.

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: The story of a young orphaned boy who is sent to live with his grandfather in Ireland. The boy finds adjusting to the country life challenging, but soon learns the life has its rewards as well.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

programme.title: Last Chance
programme.desc: In a future world, mankind is about to be wiped out by a super virus, Hiding underground people only have one hope, That a meteorite will save them with a possible cure. Only one thing stands in their way from retrieving the meteorite crystal that could save them all, The infected topsiders.

programme.title: Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Whisper Island
programme.desc: Sam Dalton, a 14-year-old girl, is determined to save the only home she has ever known, the faded, dusty Romanian Princess ranch. Sam writes to a distant relative of her Aunt Christine hoping he can prevent the ranch from being repossessed. But it's J. T. Swinton, a teenage boy who shows up. In desperation they turn to a seemingly futile hope, the treasure of Whisper Island. But does the Civil War treasure really exist? The answer seems to be trapped somewhere in the wishful delusions of Aunt Christine. As the teens search for treasure in a race against time, they must also search Christine's past and unravel a web of romance, intrigue and betrayal that spans a lifetime and beyond. What they find, changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: Ona je kriminalac
programme.desc: Sju Parker gurnuta je u očajničku borbu da spase porodični posao koji se, zbog nemara njenog oca, nalazi na ivici propasti. Dolaskom šarmantnog skitnice, ona prepoznaje jedinu nadu da spreči da njihov bar padne u ruke nemilosrdnog lokalnog tajkuna.

programme.title: Barska svađa!
programme.desc: Nina i Alen nakon raskida dele sve što su zajedno stekli u životu, ali ih očekuje urnebesna borba za vlasništvo nad njihovim dragocenim pabom. U ovoj borbi povlači se crta, bira se strana i počinje ludo takmičenje u ispijanju piva.

programme.title: Utvrđivanje smrti
programme.desc: Kako bi pobegao od ogromnih kockarskih dugova, veoma odbojni Ris Vilijams odlučuje da inscenira sopstvenu smrt, uz pomoć dugogodišnje sapatnice, supruge Kejti. Kad Ris "umre", Kejti nasleđuje pet miliona dolara od polise osiguranja, što će im pomoći da otplate dugove i započnu novi život na nekom drugom mestu. Ali, da li je moguće da prevara krene po zlu, a Ris završi zaista mrtav? Risova svastika, Džini, mogla bi obezbediti validne informacije agentima osiguranja, Loganu i Meku, od kojih je jedan zaljubljen u Kejti.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Uhvati me za ruku
programme.desc: Majka troje dece, koja živi u Londonu i nalazi se na vrhuncu karijere, saznaje da boluje od multiple skleroze. Nakon iznenadne smrti supruga i gubitka posla, vraća se u rodnu Australiju, gde slučajan susret sa srednjoškolskom ljubavi budi novu nadu u ljubav dok vodi tešku borbu sa bolešću.

programme.title: Raskinuli smo
programme.desc: Dugogodišnji partneri Lori i Dag raskidaju samo nekoliko dana pre venčanja Lorine mlađe sestre Bi i Džejsona. Da ne bi pokvarili slavlje, odlučuju da se pretvaraju da su i dalje zajedno dok vikend ne prođe.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora prisiljava na zatvaranje posla. Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

programme.title: Ubojita magija
programme.desc: Na turneji po Britaniji 1926. godine, Hari Hudini započinje strastvenu vezu sa vidovnjakinjom koja namerava da prevari sjajnog mađioničara.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Disko
programme.desc: Didje je četrdesetogodišnjak _ fan disko muzike. Muškarac nema posla i još uvek živi sa majkom. Didje ima sina, kojeg dugo nije video, ipak njegova majka ne slaže se da zajedno provedu odmor. Didje odlučuje da pobedi u plesnom konkursu, da dobije nagradu i da povede sina na nezaboravni odmor u Australiju. Muškarac nagovara svoje prijatelje da mu pomognu. Zapošljavaju trenera, koji treba da ih pripremi za takmičenje. Brzo se uspostavlja, da makar nekad bili su odlični plesači, vreme je uradilo svoje. Moraju puno da rade da bi nastupili.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec

programme.title: Ukradena dolina

programme.title: Nikad neću biti tvoja
programme.desc: Majka započinje vezu s mlađim muškarcem, dok se njena ćerka prvi put zaljubljuje. Ipak, sudbina će tu umešati prste i poigrati se njihovim životima.

programme.title: Obožavam te!
programme.desc: Grej Evans i Mia Lang su mladi glumački par čiji brak je dinamičan čak i nakon godinu dana. Glamurozne premijere i opijanja na VIP žurkama, gde mogu da se druže s Elvisom Kostelom, čitanje pošte obožavalaca i sve ono što im garantuje simpatije i naklonost publike. Ali prava slika Grejove narcisoidnosti jeste njegovo verovanje da ga neko uhodi. To možda jeste, možda i nije istina, ali njegova fiksacija je tolika da ne samo da zamišlja sopstvenu smrt, već počinje i sam da uhodi radnika video kluba, koga smatra srećnijim od sebe. Grej ujedno fantazira o običnom životu s bivšom devojkom.

programme.title: Ubice
programme.desc: Majkl Hiro, moćni direktor velike kompanije, traži osvetu za ubistvo svog unuka tako što nudi nagradu od milion dolara za likvidaciju ljudi odgovornih za nesreću koja ga je odnela. Njegova ponuda navodi najbolje ubice sveta da prihvate zadatak.

programme.title: Smrtonosni obračun

programme.title: Crni dijamant
programme.desc: Mlada žena živi naizgled savršenim životom sa svojim dečkom iz sveta investicionih fondova, sve dok susret sa lokalnim kaubojem i majstorom ne pretvori njihovu svakodnevicu u smrtonosni trougao strasti, opsesije i ubistva.

programme.title: Pad Kandahara
programme.desc: 1999 godina, britanski miner koji radi za Talibane u Avganistanu, mora da beži, kad je uvučen u smrtonosnu igru, zaveru i izdaju.

programme.title: Noćna tabla

programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Mrvica i rudnik zlata

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstva.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Pejdžina majka želi da ćerka krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, ali Pejdž želi da bude spisateljica. Kada Džoan odluči da proda izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Pejdž to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži poslednju šansu _ ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da niko, pa ni Danijel, poslednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena porodica predstavlja pretnju.

programme.title: Kralj boraca

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Draga Elizabet
programme.desc: Muškarac koji vodi dosadan život slučajno počinje da proganja staru koleginicu s fakulteta, glumicu Elizabet Benks, na društvenim mrežama. U svojim pokušajima da dokaže da je poznaje, ponovo otkriva sebe i pravo značenje prijateljstva.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Šta sve činimo zbog ljubavi
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Cigarete na komad
programme.desc: Bobi, njujorški džeparoš koji se svuda predstavlja kao broker, izaziva sudbinu kada krade značku njujorškog detektiva, na nezadovoljstvo svog izuzetno manipulativnog dilera ukradenim stvarima. Igrajući ovu opasnu igru mačke i miša, Bobi nailazi na još veći izazov: vezu za jednu noć, s devojkom po imenu Lusi. Tri meseca nakon strastvene zajedničke noći, Lusi mu saopštava da je trudna. Iznenada, dva potpuno različita sveta se sudaraju, što Bobiju nalaže da preispita dotadašnji život. U gradu za koji je nekad bio nevidljiv, Bobi je sada prilično poznat i tražen.

programme.title: Pravda za sve

programme.desc: Petnaest godina nakon ubistva svoje starije sestre, ćutljivi Danijel zaljubljuje se u živahnu srednjoškolku Kasi, u priči nadahnutoj južnjačkim gotikom, koja donosi savremenu verziju Romea i Julije, smeštenu u srce Amerike.

programme.desc: Using a conventional Western story with an all dwarf cast, the filmmakers were able to showcase gags such as cowboys entering the local saloon by walking under the swinging doors, and pint-sized cowboys galloping around on Shetland ponies while roping calves.

programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: Black Dragons
programme.desc: A cabal of American industrialists, all fifth-columnists intent on sabotaging the war effort, are methodically murdered by the malevolent Monsieur Colomb.

programme.desc: Joe Beck leaves Central America so that he can return to Texas and collect a large inheritance, but he picks a dangerous ship on which to travel.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.desc: When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause. However, Lila, though dead, has developed a will of her own.

programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: The Inner Circle
programme.desc: A private detective finds himself with a perfect new secretary. But after a notorious gossip columnist turns up murdered, she may prove too good to be true.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.title: Road Gate
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. They are separated by a toll-bar between wealth and poverty. One day Aidar and Rauan will clash and their worlds will clash. What will the results be..?

programme.title: Desert Storm
programme.desc: Chet Kasedon is after the Indians hidden gold mine but Chief Moya will not reveal it's location. He has also hired mining engineers Gale and Mortimer to locate the mine. When Gale sees Kasedon's cruelty to Moya, he switches sides.

programme.title: Abiura
programme.desc: Fofo, a humble and honest retired worker, loads strange people into his old van to accompany them to the polling station.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Titus & Mirabella
programme.desc: Two people who have never had a relationship before are on their first date together. Both long passionately for a relationship, but this first date is a nuisance for both of them. They try, they really do, but one accident after another occurs and nothing goes according to their expectations.

programme.title: The Amazing Adventure
programme.desc: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr. Wong
programme.desc: Mr. Wong is a "harmless" Chinatown shopkeeper by day and relentless blood-thirsty pursuer of the Twelve Coins of Confucius by night. With possession of the coins, Mr. Wong will be supreme ruler of the Chinese province of Keelat, and his evil destiny will be fulfilled. A killing spree follows in dark and dangerous Chinatown as Wong gets control of 11 of the 12 coins. Reporter Jason Barton and his girl Peg are hot on his trail, but soon find themselves in serious trouble when they stumble onto Wong's headquarters.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Terror by Night
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

But when his former employer and his old drug dealer re-enter his life, Frankie finds it hard to stay clean and eventually finds himself succumbing to his old habits.

Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

Doc is trailing his stolen horse, and it is discovered in the possession of Billy the Kid. In a surprising turnaround, Billy and Doc become friends. This causes the friendship between Doc and Pat to cool. The odd relationship between Doc and Billy grows stranger when Doc hides Billy at his girl Rio's place after Billy is shot.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: Charade

programme.title: Frieda
programme.desc: A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Humans have long dreamed of flight—from da Vinci's flapping-wing designs to massive cow-gut-filled airships. The Wright brothers, inspired by bicycles, built strong, controllable kites that led to early planes. Modern jets fly faster thanks to high-altitude, low-resistance flight, an idea sparked by Frank Whittle's Aeolipile experiments. From the Airbus A380 to NASA's scramjet, aviation keeps evolving—what's next in flight innovation?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Forests are crucial for our survival on Earth. They absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and supply all living forms with clean oxygen. "We are like a patient in a hospital bed that is turning down their oxygen tank and thinking they could live with a little bit less oxygen and meanwhile the CO2 is increasing in the room" says journalist Andrew Nikiforuk.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the deadly majesty of volcanoes—one of Earth's most destructive forces. Around 4,000 volcanoes exist worldwide, with about 50 erupting annually, releasing millions of tons of ash and gases and threatening lives. From Iceland's Eyjafjallajökull to Indonesia, volcanoes remind us nature can change plans anytime. Most dangerous are supervolcanoes like Yellowstone, whose eruption is 5-10 times more likely than an asteroid impact.

programme.desc: America's military history is on display on the decks of the USS North Carolina. Then we visit the historic Confederate Fort Fisher civil war museum and learn about the Carolina's role in the civil war.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: The live music capital of the US has an interesting past. Take an in depth look at one of Austin's oldest hotels, The Driskill. Then we'll learn about Texan independence in the Bob Bullock History museum. Finally, we'll end up at one of Austin's most historic buildings, the Texas state capitol.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Ranthambore National Park is part of Project Tiger, a unique wildlife conservation program set up to insure the preservation of the magnificent Tiger. In Ranthambore we encounter the tiger along with Sambar and Blue Bull, Wild Boar and Langur Monkey. We also explore the historic side of Ranthambore which is dotted with ruins of the fort that protected the region for hundreds of years. We end the episode with a tour of a very different national park. Board a rickshaw and join your guide as he explores Keoladeo National Park, known for its abundant bird life.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: India can match Africa mega-animal for mega-animal. The three biggest—elephant, buffalo and rhino are found in large numbers in only one national park in India—Kazaringa. Join Bill as he attempts to check each of these highly endangered and dangerous herbivores off his bucket list.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: To this day sisal, a rope making fiber plant, is a mainstay of the economy. Journeys tours the capital city of Tanzania and its diverse religious institutions before heading into sisal country. We'll learn about the German influences and the seldom heard story of Livingstone's final trip across Africa.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: From the streets of Soweto to the colonial Union Building, the metro area of Joburg is a mix of architecture, people and traditions. Johannesburg is more than just a big city—it's also home to one of the world's best safari parks.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A magnificent journey of cultural enrichment and hair raising heli-skiing in Beautiful British Columbia.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Follow some of the biggest names in freestyle motocross as they prepare for the "Dew Action Sports Tour," being held in Salt Lake City.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Chanel No. 5, the Legendary Perfume
programme.desc: A revolutionary fragrance needs a visionary woman to create it! Gabrielle Chanel, the woman liberated others from corsage made the delightful perfume Chanel N°5 which remains the symbol of elegance around the world. This documentary will take you to Grasse to Paris & tell you the story of the legendary perfume.

programme.title: In the Starlight
programme.desc: In the Starlight is an intimate portrayal about the life of nature photographer Paul Zizka and his quest to capture the night skies.

programme.title: Lagerfield - The Kaiser Of Fashion
programme.desc: A biography of the controversial fashion savant, creator of extraordinary fashion show sets, renowned photographer, and author of breathtaking books. Lagerfeld is the quintessential renaissance man.

programme.title: Cosmic
programme.desc: In the wake of COVID19, students, doctors, engineers, from all around British Columbia, Canada, formed an Open Source community to create innovative PPE devices to limit the spread of the virus.

programme.title: Tailored Humanity: A Revolution in Genetics
programme.desc: Thanks to a molecular device called CRISPR-Cas9, editing DNA will soon be as easy as pressing a button. This technology could help us wipe out all sorts of diseases, but it would also make it possible to order a "programmed" human embryo. The economic and ethical impacts of such a discovery are overwhelming. Can we forge life and evolution according to our needs? Should we?

programme.title: Alien Invaders!
programme.desc: Alien Invaders is a documentary special that throws three young, but experienced, hosts into the world of invasive species of animals, fish, birds, insects, viruses and plants to create television mayhem. The show looks at invasions of aggressive non-indigenous animals around the world. Pacific lionfish are eating their way through the Caribbean, Burmese pythons are infesting the Everglades, African killer bees have worked their way north from Brazil to Utah, Asian carp are now swimming in the millions from New Orleans to Chicago. These and many other "alien invaders" are the villains (and stars!) of our show.

programme.title: Alien Invaders!

programme.title: The Tigers From Scotland
programme.desc: Narrated by Iain Glen, this film focuses on the fragile existence of the Scottish Wildcats, their status and what conservation efforts are being undertaken to ensure their survival.

programme.title: Japanese Heights
programme.desc: There is more to Japan's natural landscape than just Mount Fuji! Discover the country's numerous mountains and the ethos of the people who live there. From mountains with eight peaks, mountain gods who keep locals in their awe to building snow monsters & embracing modern activities like skiing _ this documentary shows the unseen side to Japan!

programme.title: Coral Sea Dreaming
programme.desc: Coral Sea Dreaming enters into the very heart of life _ and death _ on a coral reef. It is a story that spans 500 million years and stars some of the most exotic and wonderous marine creatures on earth. Coral is the planet's greatest natu- ral architect, and coral reefs boast the highest biodiversity of any ecosystem.

programme.title: Karen Twins
programme.desc: When they were kids, Johnny and Luther Htoo were invincible. This is at least what believed "God's Army" soldiers, a Karen guerilla group led by the 12 years old twin brothers. Today, Johnny and Luther are 27 years old. Their past glory is long gone, and their respective lives illustrate the fate of Burmese ethnic minorities who dare confronting the central government.

programme.title: Seed Hunter
programme.desc: Our planet is heating up and one of the first casualties will be the crops that supply our food. Scientists are working overtime to find solutions including going back to the ancestral origins of our staple foods. SEED HUNTER will take you on a remarkable journey from the drought ravaged farms of Australia, to the heart of the Middle East, to the mountains of Tajikistan where charismatic Australian scientist Dr Ken Street _ a real life version of Indiana Jones _ and his team of "gene detectives" hunt for plant genes that will help our food withstand the impact of 21st century global warming. Along the way we meet farmers around the world who are struggling to grow crops in a climate that's gone haywire, as well as scientists working at the front line of gene technology to save tomorrow's food. At journey's end, deep in the Arctic Circle, Ken deposits his bounty of seed in the newly constructed seed bank known as the "doomsday vault."

programme.title: The Stradivarius Complex
programme.desc: From his atelier in Barcelona, David Bagué, one of the world's most talented and charismatic luthiers, dedicates body and soul to making violins with a single purpose: to reach the transcendence Stradivarius' violins achieved.

programme.title: Madre De Dios: The Lost Island
programme.desc: In January 2017, a team of researchers set out on one of the last major geographic expeditions to Madre de Dios Island — a true terra incognita in the heart of Patagonia and Chilean Antarctica. To carry out this risky mission, speleologists, divers, geologists, botanists, and biologists faced extreme conditions while exploring this remote land, aiming to establish it as a UNESCO World Heritage site.

programme.title: Shattered Ground
programme.desc: Hydraulic Fracturing or "Fracking" is a new technology that has opened up immense resources of natural gas buried in deep shale beds. Some see it as the answer to the energy crisis and a chance at energy independence. But fracking has become an incredibly divisive issue ripping apart communities and even families. The backlash is unprecedented, with states and countries adopting fracking bans. Shattered Ground is a one hour documentary that looks past the rhetoric and emotional arguments to find the real issues involved in hydraulic fracturing, the opportunity, and the potential health and environmental issues that will affect us all.

programme.title: Lagerfield - The Kaiser Of Fashion
programme.desc: A biography of the controversial fashion savant, creator of extraordinary fashion show sets, renowned photographer, and author of breathtaking books. Lagerfeld is the quintessential renaissance man.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We'll find out why they called Minneapolis the "Mill City" when we visit the Mill City Museum. Then we march over to the Union's Fort Snelling, the first permanent structure in Minnesota, and then head underground and learn about St. Paul's organized crime hide outs.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: San Antonio is rich with Texas, Mexican, and Spanish history. We make our last stand at the Alamo, and visit Missions National Historical Park. Lastly, we spelunk the Natural Bridge Caverns underground.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Catch-and-release Chinook Salmon derby from Vancouver promoting Pacific Salmon Foundation!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

Bill helps raise the Chinese fishing nets at dusk and tour a 1000 year old boat yard, where luxury vessels are still handcrafted.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Every major country has a destination that is incredible but not well known to outsiders—Jaisalmer is such a place. Once a major stop along the silk road, this living museum and surrounding countryside has something for everyone: tragic history, unbelievable architecture, unique cultural groups and resilient wildlife.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is one of the few national parks in Africa where the bush meets the ocean. The big game of Africa face off with the creatures of the deep. Our host goes a little rogue for supper and tries his hand at surf netting prawns after spending a day looking for the elusive elephants of Saadani.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: In all previous Journeys' shows, only glimpses of the cheetah were seen. Here at Kruger, we get up close to this shy cat before heading out of the park and visiting a special research and breeding center dedicated to cheetahs.

programme.title: China Uncovered
programme.desc: China runs on two gears as it moves millions of people around every day. A young driver of one of the world's fastest trains and two seasoned pilots of one of the world's biggest airlines are seeing the effects modernization and globalization have on their journeys. Meanwhile, in downtown Shanghai a recreational revolution is taking place as the youth choose bikes and skateboards over four wheels.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: Napoleon Bonaparte _ Military genius and builder, he will then reign, without any intention to share his position, for over a decade and will engage, with his troupes, in many battles. His imperial army, which has reached 700 000 men, is considered in 1815, the greatest one in the world.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Paris - Berlin: Shapes and Shades of History
programme.desc: Paris and Berlin have developed and grown facing each other over four centuries of tumultuous historical relationships and mutual admiration. The architecture and urbanism bear witness of this complex and rich confrontation.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: The Obersalzberg was an ordinary Bavarian mountain until Adolf Hitler discovered it in 1923. There at the Berghof, the Nazi leader spent his time surrounded by his most faithful lieutenants and his mistress, Eva Braun. Though mostly destroyed, remnants of the vast building complex still exist.

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: On May 28, 1940, the Wehrmacht crushed the Allied armies in France. The British prepared for a deal with Hitler, even considering mediation through Mussolini. Left alone in the war cabinet, Churchill, with his cunning and will, finally persuaded his associates to go to war.
